column1: # bb-image managed.tsv
# Files and shell rc blocks the image hydrates into the home volume on every
# container start. Columns, tab-separated:
#   target  location inside the volume, relative to $HOME (or the bb data dir
#           for the .bb/ prefix, honouring BB_DATA_DIR)
#   mode    "file" (the target is wholly owned; the whole file is replaced) or
#           "block" (only the lines between the managed markers are replaced)
#   source  file under /usr/local/share/bb holding the shipped content
# A fourth hash column is appended by `hydrate-home.sh stamp` at build time; it
# holds the sha256 of the source. The hash column is deliberately not kept in
# this file: a hand-edited hash could silently mask drift between the source
# and what shipped volumes already have.
# When you change a source's content in a commit, first append the hash it
# replaces to managed-prev.tsv (`<target><TAB><hash>`), so volumes carrying the
# old shipped copy are recognised as ours and updated. Copies a user edited are
# left untouched, that is the whole point of the hash comparison.
# target
.bb/AGENTS.md
.bashrc
.zshrc
